entities.summary: Duane Martin is an American actor. He began his career making appearances on numerous television sitcoms before starring as Robert James on the UPN/CW sitcom All of Us (2003–2007) and as Detective Ben Baines on the police-procedural series L.A.'s Finest. Martin has also appeared in many films throughout his career including White Men Can't Jump (1992), Above the Rim and The Inkwell, The Faculty and Woo, Deliver Us from Eva and Ride or Die, and The Seat Filler (2004).
